title.zh: 币安疑似遭黑客攻击，约56亿美元被盗

current_state.zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；初步指向DevOps工程师笔记本电脑被入侵，但已发现更多入侵点，且并非单一“一键式”操作。约30亿美元资产已冻结，存款正常，提现暂停并预计约48小时内恢复。分析人士将攻击归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor，部分被盗资金与 Bitget 事件资金混同；损失将由 SAFU 和公司资金覆盖。
current_state.en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; preliminary findings pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer laptop, but additional breach points have been found and the incident was not a single 'one-click' action. About $3B in assets has been frozen, deposits are operating normally, and withdrawals are paused with resumption expected within about 48 hours. Analysts attribute the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor, some stolen funds were commingled with Bitget exploit funds, and losses will be covered by SAFU and company funds.

updates.title_zh: Binance-hacker-1029 – Binance 被盗 56 亿美元

updates.what_changed_en: Binance suffered a $5.6B hack — the largest exchange theft ever — that reportedly wiped out its ~$1B SAFU insurance fund, with about $2.4B of the stolen USDT/USDC already frozen by Tether and Circle.

updates.title_zh: Binance黑客集群持仓监控：涉案65个币种总计58.75亿美元，其中25.4亿美元已被冻结
updates.title_en: Binance黑客集群持仓监控：涉案65个币种总计58.75亿美元，其中25.4亿美元已被冻结
updates.what_changed_zh: Arkham数据显示，Binance黑客集群地址现持有约58.75亿美元、覆盖65个币种；Binance称已联合多方冻结约25.4亿美元涉案资金。
updates.what_changed_en: Arkham data shows the Binance hacker cluster now holds about $5.875 billion across 65 tokens, and Binance says it has coordinated the freezing of about $2.54 billion in stolen funds.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance仍在调查该起黑客事件；黑客集群地址持有约58.75亿美元、65个币种资产，Binance称已联合冻结约25.4亿美元涉案资金。
updates.current_state_en: Binance is still investigating the hack; the hacker cluster holds about $5.875 billion across 65 tokens, and Binance says about $2.54 billion of the stolen funds has been frozen through coordination.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Arkham data shows the Binance hacker cluster now holds $5.875B across 65 tokens — led by $1.77B USDT, 18.27K BTC, 460.6K ETH, and $823M USDC — while Binance says it has coordinated the freezing of $2.54B of the stolen funds.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Arkham data shows the Binance hacker cluster now holds $5.875B across 65 tokens — led by $1.77B USDT, 18.27K BTC, 460.6K ETH, and $823M USDC — while Binance says it has coordinated the freezing of $2.54B of the stolen funds.

updates.title_zh: 【何一：Binance 暂停提币，直至确认环境安全，用户资金安全】
updates.title_en: 【何一：Binance 暂停提币，直至确认环境安全，用户资金安全】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安联合创始人何一表示，币安已暂停提币直至确认相关环境安全，并称用户资金安全（SAFU）；World Liberty Financial 协助冻结 2700 万美元 USD1 及 4800 万枚 WLFI（价值约 200 万美元）。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance co-founder Yi He said the exchange has paused withdrawals until it confirms the environment is secure, asserted user funds remain safe under SAFU, and thanked World Liberty Financial for helping freeze $27 million in USD1 plus 48 million WLFI tokens (worth about $2 million).
updates.current_state_zh: 币安已暂停提币直至确认相关环境安全；黑客事件仍在调查中，此前币安称已联合冻结约25.4亿美元涉案资金，World Liberty Financial 协助冻结2700万美元USD1及4800万枚WLFI（约200万美元）。
updates.current_state_en: Binance has paused withdrawals until it confirms the environment is secure; the hack remains under investigation, with Binance previously saying about $2.54 billion in stolen funds had been frozen through coordination, and World Liberty Financial helped freeze $27 million in USD1 plus 48 million WLFI tokens (about $2 million).
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance co-founder Yi He announced the exchange has halted withdrawals until it confirms its environment is secure, asserting user funds remain safe under SAFU and thanking World Liberty Financial for helping freeze $27 million in USD1 plus 48 million WLFI tokens.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance co-founder Yi He announced the exchange has halted withdrawals until it confirms its environment is secure, asserting user funds remain safe under SAFU and thanking World Liberty Financial for helping freeze $27 million in USD1 plus 48 million WLFI tokens.

updates.title_zh: 币安将63亿美元被盗事件归咎于工程师被入侵的笔记本电脑
updates.title_en: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance初步调查称，攻击者可能通过被入侵的DevOps工程师笔记本电脑进入服务容器并提交未经授权的提币交易，未发现私钥泄露证据；Binance将影响估计上调至约63亿美元，并称已冻结约30亿美元资产，计划用SAFU和公司资金覆盖损失、撤销受影响地址授权并更新储备证明。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance's preliminary investigation says attackers may have used a compromised DevOps engineer laptop to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence of private-key leakage; Binance raised the estimated impact to about $6.3 billion, said about $3 billion was frozen, and plans to cover losses via SAFU and company funds, revoke the affected address authorization, and publish updated Proof of Reserves.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance事件仍在调查中；初步指向DevOps设备被入侵和签名基础设施被滥用，而非私钥泄露。影响估计约63亿美元，约30亿美元已冻结，存取款曾暂停，受影响地址授权已撤销，损失将由SAFU和公司资金覆盖，详细技术复盘待发布。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance incident remains under investigation; preliminary findings point to a compromised DevOps device and signing-infrastructure misuse rather than private-key leakage. Estimated impact is about $6.3 billion, about $3 billion has been frozen, deposits/withdrawals were temporarily suspended, the affected address authorization was revoked, losses will be covered by SAFU and company funds, and a detailed technical post-mortem is pending.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance's preliminary investigation into its $6.3B breach points to a hacked DevOps engineer's laptop used to access internal infrastructure and push unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence found of a private-key leak.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance's preliminary investigation into its $6.3B breach points to a hacked DevOps engineer's laptop used to access internal infrastructure and push unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence found of a private-key leak.

updates.title_zh: Blockaid披露黑客如何控制币安钱包：50个EIP-7702账户之一
updates.title_en: Blockaid Reveals How Hacker Took Control of Binance Wallet: One of 50 EIP-7702 A
updates.what_changed_zh: Blockaid 分析披露攻击者通过单笔 Type-4 交易提交 50 个不同 nonce 的 EIP-7702 授权，仅一个匹配成功，将 Binance 14 热钱包委托给未经验证的恶意转账合约；该合约仅允许攻击者指定地址调用 sweep()，可转走 ETH 和 ERC-20 代币并保留 1 ETH 作为 gas。
updates.what_changed_en: Blockaid analysis disclosed that the attacker submitted 50 EIP-7702 authorizations with different nonces in a single Type-4 transaction; only one matched, delegating the Binance 14 hot wallet to an unverified malicious transfer contract. The contract only lets the attacker-designated address call sweep(), allowing ETH and ERC-20 tokens to be transferred while retaining 1 ETH for gas.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance 事件仍在调查中；此前初步指向 DevOps 设备被入侵和签名基础设施被滥用，影响估计约63亿美元，约30亿美元已冻结，存取款曾暂停，受影响地址授权已撤销，损失将由 SAFU 和公司资金覆盖。Blockaid 进一步分析称，攻击者利用 EIP-7702 授权机制，通过单笔交易提交 50 个不同 nonce 的授权，仅一个成功，使 Binance 14 热钱包被委托给恶意 sweep 合约。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance incident remains under investigation; preliminary findings pointed to a compromised DevOps device and signing-infrastructure misuse, with estimated impact about $6.3B, about $3B frozen, deposits/withdrawals temporarily suspended, the affected address authorization revoked, and losses to be covered by SAFU and company funds. Blockaid further analyzed that the attacker exploited EIP-7702 authorization by submitting 50 different-nonce authorizations in one transaction; only one succeeded, delegating the Binance 14 hot wallet to a malicious sweep contract.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Blockaid detailed how an attacker gained control of Binance's Binance 14 hot wallet by submitting 50 EIP-7702 authorizations with different nonces in a single Type-4 transaction, with the one matching authorization delegating the account to a malicious contract capable of sweeping ETH and ERC-20 tokens while leaving 1 ETH for gas.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Blockaid detailed how an attacker gained control of Binance's Binance 14 hot wallet by submitting 50 EIP-7702 authorizations with different nonces in a single Type-4 transaction, with the one matching authorization delegating the account to a malicious contract capable of sweeping ETH and ERC-20 tokens while leaving 1 ETH for gas.

updates.title_zh: 币安攻击者存入6000万美元USDT并借出后，Aave 冻结 V3 和 V4 市场
updates.title_en: Aave Freezes V3 and V4 Markets After Binance Exploiter Deposits $60M USDT and Bo
updates.what_changed_zh: 在一个与币安攻击者关联的钱包存入约6000万美元USDT并在几分钟前借出19762枚WETH（约合4460万美元）后，Aave 冻结了所有由 DAO 运营的 V3 和 V4 市场；该头寸仍处于开放状态但超额抵押，据称 Aave 的合约未受影响。
updates.what_changed_en: Aave froze every DAO-operated V3 and V4 market after a wallet linked to the Binance exploiter deposited about 60 million USDT and borrowed 19,762 WETH (roughly $44.6M) minutes earlier, with the position still open but over-collateralized and Aave's contracts reportedly unaffected.

updates.title_zh: 实时更新：币安在63亿美元黑客事件中发现更多入侵点
updates.title_en: Live updates: Binance uncovers more breach points in $6.3B hack
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安调查发现除最初指向的工程师笔记本电脑外还有更多入侵点；联合CEO Richard Teng 表示这不是单一“一键式”操作，未将责任归咎于任何个人；存款正常运行，提现仍暂停并预计约48小时内恢复；分析人士将攻击归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor，并称被盗资金与 Bitget 事件资金在同一地址混同。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance's investigation uncovered additional breach points beyond the initially cited engineer laptop; co-CEO Richard Teng said the incident was not a single 'one-click' action and did not attribute responsibility to any individual; deposits remain normal while withdrawals are paused and expected to resume within about 48 hours; analysts attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor and said stolen funds were commingled with Bitget exploit funds in the same address.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；初步指向DevOps工程师笔记本电脑被入侵，但已发现更多入侵点，且并非单一“一键式”操作。约30亿美元资产已冻结，存款正常，提现暂停并预计约48小时内恢复。分析人士将攻击归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor，部分被盗资金与 Bitget 事件资金混同；损失将由 SAFU 和公司资金覆盖。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; preliminary findings pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer laptop, but additional breach points have been found and the incident was not a single 'one-click' action. About $3B in assets has been frozen, deposits are operating normally, and withdrawals are paused with resumption expected within about 48 hours. Analysts attribute the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor, some stolen funds were commingled with Bitget exploit funds, and losses will be covered by SAFU and company funds.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance disclosed an estimated $6.3 billion hack, reported about $3 billion in stolen assets already frozen across stablecoins, tokenized gold and ETH derivatives, said deposits remain operational with withdrawals expected to resume within 48 hours, and identified additional breach points while analysts attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance disclosed an estimated $6.3 billion hack, reported about $3 billion in stolen assets already frozen across stablecoins, tokenized gold and ETH derivatives, said deposits remain operational with withdrawals expected to resume within 48 hours, and identified additional breach points while analysts attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.
